title: HumanTask
description: The workflow primitive transported by HumanGateway: a request for human input or approval, correlated to the consumer workflow (FlowForge PendingHumanTask: nodeId, role, prompt, subject). Lifecycle: REQUESTED → DELIVERED_TO_HUMAN → RESPONSE_RECEIVED → COMPLETED, or EXPIRED (product vision §10). HumanGateway transports the task; the consumer owns task semantics and authorisation (NG1, SP-09).

kind.description: human-input (free text / choice) or human-approval (approve / reject with reason) (FLOW-FR-05).

workflowRef.description: Consumer workflow/run identifier; passed through unchanged.

nodeId.description: Workflow node that requested the interaction (FlowForge nodeId).

role.description: Role required to answer (e.g. 'teacher', 'reviewer'). HumanGateway does not enforce it; the consumer enforces authorisation (SP-09).

prompt.description: The question or instruction presented to the human.

subject.description: Short subject / title of the task.

options.description: Choice options for kind=input prompts with a choice-style answer.

requestMessageId.description: ID of the Message envelope carrying the task request.

responseMessageId.description: ID of the Message envelope carrying the human's response, once answered.

response.description: The human's response. Populated once answered.

decision.description: Approve / reject (kind=approval). Required when an approval task carries a response.

reason.description: Optional reason accompanying an approval decision or an input answer.

artifactRefs.description: Evidence attached by the human (photo, PDF, ...), referenced — never embedded (PROTO-FR-04).

correlationToken.description: Opaque consumer correlation token passed through unchanged so consumers enforce role-checks and audit (SP-09, AUTH-FR-06).

expiresAt.description: When set, the task transitions to EXPIRED if not completed by this time.

deliveredToHumanAt.description: When the task was presented to the human.

responseReceivedAt.description: When the human's response was received.

createdAt.description: When the task record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the task record last changed.

allOf.description: An approval task, once answered, must carry a decision.
REQUESTED must record when it was requested.
DELIVERED_TO_HUMAN must record when it was delivered.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED must carry the response and its message.
COMPLETED must carry the response, its message, and the completion time.
EXPIRED must record when it expired.
